newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down two cents to 14.35 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down two cents to 14.35 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell two cents to 14.35 ringgit ($5.81) a kg after tracking a steady close on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The (local) market just corrected slightly after following the LME," said a trader. The London market closed unchanged on Friday.
There were 109 tonnes offered for sale against 91 bids for purchase. Buyers were Europeans and locals. Final turnover was at 96 tonnes, same as Friday.
The local premium against London widened to $110 from $90.
